attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.6.10 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine, apk-installed, OpenRC-managed, enabled at boot). Verified cross-member read/write consistency, verified the cluster keeps serving reads/writes with one member down and that member catches up on rejoin, then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
